title: Return of the Fearsome Threesome: Fetzer, Hagopian, and Winter
text:
The US has struck back on Iran after it took out an Apache chopper, but Iran has increased its security belt and can defend itself more effectively than in the past. Col. Macgregor explains that Trump is boxed in and looking for a way out, but Israel thwarts his every attempt. Iran has begun attacking Israeli settlers in the occupied territories after Israel continued its attacks on Lebanon. Pakistan has reported that Israel has sabotaged peace deals at every juncture and wants the war to continue–but should that happen, its prospects for survival as a nation go from slim to none.
Iran has announced ‘Operation Victory’ as Yemen closes Bab al-Mandab Strait to Israeli shipping, 22 generals just sent Congress an urgent warning: The US Air Force has never been this old, this small, or this unready, The Pentagon raised Israel’s counterintelligence threat level to “critical”.
A visit to WinterWatch.net shared many stories, including Albanian protests against Jared and Ivanka’s plan to buy an island and New Yorkers protests against DJT for disrupting their lives by attending the Knicks’ game at Madison Square Garden.
